purpose: D4 first manual batch: unregistered named entities in the judged text. count=null means NOT CHECKED (never guessed); a checked text with nothing found is 0.
labeler: assistant-manual (single labeler, same session that built the archive)

fields.snippet: verbatim text fragment naming the entity
fields.isError: true when the labeler believes the name is a genuine unregistered entity

annotations.snippet: 这时管线丙从巷口走来

unlabeled: every case not listed here has count=null: no label exists, so nothing can be concluded about missed names there

counting.falsePositive: a labeled snippet that is actually a registered name or a generic noun
counting.falseNegative: a text that names a new entity but carries no label

thisBatch.note: false negatives need a second, independent labeler over the unlabeled texts; a single labeler cannot measure their own misses
